cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — sitting on the ground; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — seated sideways on a stool or bench; her living room with a deep sofa — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a present-day coastal tidal bathing pool carved into pale limestone — standing on a dry step after a swim; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — holds a cup in both hands; the Changban Bridge memorial — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a present-day outdoor orchard picnic clearing on a sunny hillside — taking a first bite of a peach after a long walk; a medieval tavern — seated on a chair; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — carries a pipa lute by its neck at her side; a mossy path under ancient oaks with shafts of light — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a second-hand book stall under an awning on a quiet street — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height
